articles.title_en: Ukraine’s air-raid sirens can sound for 10 hours a day. Its economy minister says every hour costs $45 million.
articles.lead_en: Air raid alerts warning of Russian attacks cost Ukraine about $45 million an hour, Ukrainian Economy and Environment Minister Oleksandr Kravchenko estimated in an interview with The Guardian.
